reason: This text is Ezekiel 37 (the vision of dry bones), a prophecy about divine restoration and resurrection. The passage focuses entirely on God's power to resurrect Israel as a nation and Ezekiel's role as a prophet delivering God's message. There is no discussion of leadership models, criticism, or humility in response to criticism. While Ezekiel obeys God's commands, the text does not present any model of leadership responding humbly to criticism—it is purely a divine prophecy with no critical feedback or interpersonal conflict related to leadership.
